caveat: Weights multiply predicted action probabilities in the For You value model. They are not engagement counts. A browser extension cannot compute those probabilities. Checks below only look at draft features and hard filters described in the pinned commit.

weights.label: bidirectional-follow reply boost
weights.note: Original posts only. Replies are not eligible. See xai-value-model/inputs.rs bidirectional_boost_eligible.

weights.label: continuous dwell time
weights.note: Multiplies predicted seconds, not a probability.

replyRisks.summary: The reply grader is told whether the reply text was pasted.

sources.note: Renders the line “Reply Was Pasted” into the grader prompt.

replyRisks.summary: The reply grader sees the author's reply count over the last 24 hours.
The reply grader sees how many legit blocks the author received in the last 24 hours.
Replies are Grok-graded when the parent or root author has more than 250,000 followers. Self-replies are skipped.
The reply scorer returns a score from 0 to 3. How scores 1–3 are ordered in the conversation view is not in this repo.
A reply score of 0 adds RiskyHighVizReply, which drops the reply for non-followers, including notifications. High-cred and grey-badge accounts are exempt.

sources.note: Exempt when user cred >= 66 or grey badge.

replyRisks.summary: An existing reply-ranking score is kept unless the new score is lower.
llm_slop_post adds RiskyHighVizReply for 30 days (2592000000 ms).
llm_slop_user adds the user label SpamHighRecall for 7 days (604800000 ms), which drops that user's posts.
fast_reply_spam_post adds SpamHighRecall. The production rate threshold is not in the repo.

SpamEngagementBaiting, SpamEngagementFarming, SpamCardManipulation, and SpamPromotesShares apply SpamHighRecall, which drops the post for non-authors. SpamPromotesReplies and SpamPromotesClicks only add Promotes* labels. A separate head-zeroing switch for those labels is off at this commit.

Policy types include SpamHashTagAbuse, SpamMentionAbuse, and SpamScamLinks. Spam types other than the Promotes* exceptions apply SpamHighRecall unless the author is high-PageRank. Published numeric cutoffs for hashtags and mentions are not in the repo.
Posts labeled DUPLICATE_CONTENT are dropped for non-authors.
Text length, newlines, URLs, and media are model features. URLs count as 23 weighted characters. There is no hand-set length or media threshold.
The +15 bidirectional reply boost applies to original posts from mutuals, not to replies.
Out-of-network replies are dropped unless EnablePhoenixOonReplies, which defaults to false. A reply reaches For You for followers.
